WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantity
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
), stats AS (
  SELECT product_color, quantity,
         1.0 * quantity / SUM(quantity) OVER () AS share,
         AVG(quantity) OVER () AS average_quantity
  FROM color_totals
)
SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(quantity - average_quantity) AS average_excess_quantity
FROM stats
WHERE quantity > average_quantity;
